description: Vantaan pyöräilijämäärät is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vantaan kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. Number of cyclists in Vantaa on an hourly basis since 2015. Vuodet 2017- Locations and number of cyclists at Vantaa Ecocounter counting points as of 12 July 2017. The new material has been made due to a change in the calculation method. The material does not distinguish between directions. Coverage: Vantaan kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. The publisher named on the listing is Vantaan kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. Its keywords include pyöräliikenne, liikenne, liikennemäärät, cyclists, pyöräily, cycling. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
